originalTitle: Gentoo bugzilla closed due AI bot scraper overload
content: I've taken #Gentoo Bugzilla down, because it was unusable anyway. No point in feeding the #LLM scrapers that are using thousands of different IPv4 addresses, with no obvious patterns I can see. EDIT: I'm not looking for hints. I'm not a sysadmin, and I don't have time to deal with this shit. I'm just trying to get some useful job done. I'm not supposed to have to be dealing with this. #AI #NoAI #NoLLM
chineseTitle: Gentoo bugzilla 由于 AI bot scraper 过载而关闭
chineseContent: 我已经把#Gentoo Bugzilla 拿下来了，因为它无论如何都无法使用。为使用数千个不同 IPv4 地址的#LLM 抓取工具提供数据是没有意义的，而且我看不到明显的模式。编辑：我不是在寻找提示。我不是系统管理员，我没有时间处理这些事情。我只是想完成一些有用的工作。我不应该处理这件事。 #AI #NoAI #NoLLM
